name: manual_3819a1
claim: Until orama PR 491 is merged and deployed, a bare lan_peer_assign drop --peer can select the plain portal port and queue the send on the wrong port when only the HTTPS front end is reachable: pass the TLS port explicitly. lan_peer_send.py is part of the same PR, so it exists only on that branch until the merge. After the fix is deployed the default follows the TLS configuration (peer TLS enabled and a CA or pins configured) and an explicit port still wins. Check which version is deployed before relying on the default.

decisions.notes: Accepted per review of PT PR 492: the TLS-aware default applies only after orama PR 491 is deployed; the explicit TLS-port workaround stays, and lan_peer_send.py availability is qualified.

rationale: Accepted per review of PT PR 492: the TLS-aware default applies only after orama PR 491 is deployed; the explicit TLS-port workaround stays, and lan_peer_send.py availability is qualified.
